summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into victory at Las Vegas, navigating 34 lead changes to emerge from the chaos with his first win of the race weekend. Ferrari's collision between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc punctuated a chaotic afternoon that left the team facing fresh questions about their drivers' ability to race together cleanly. With two races remaining and Verstappen still 98 points behind championship leader Andrea Kimi Antonelli, the Red Bull driver's Las Vegas triumph offers momentum heading into the final rounds.
